title: Jesus heals a paralytic
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.title: Words of Jesus towards the patient

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
Comparison of the blaspheming and glorification.
The parallel structure is contrast between the scribe and the people. Though the scribe thought that Jesus is blaspheming, the people praised God because of Jesus's healing. The latter part also emphasizes about relationship between forgiveness of sins and the authority of Jesus
